verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate, and per-user overrides that force specific users into a variant for testing or QA. Its first-feature tutorial explicitly targets internal testers, which covers the allowlist, beta-tester and internal-account use cases. missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding specific individual users (blocklist/fail overrides), detail on managing override lists (e.g. by user ID or bulk), independent or hands-on corroboration.
